verdict.rationale: Claude Code supports MCP server configuration (add/remove servers, scoped project/user config) and enterprise controls like managed policy settings and role-based permissions via Claude for Enterprise, which give admins some ability to govern tool/integration access. However, evidence lacks explicit fine-grained allow/deny lists for specific tools per engineering-lead control, and community commentary raises security/trust concerns about undisclosed injected tools and data handling, suggesting real-world control is imperfect.
